//: Dedicated typecheck for the WebdriverIO + tauri-driver real-backend e2e harness (#155). REFERENCED from tsconfig.json (#3664), like tsconfig.e2e.json and unlike this file's previous state. `tsc -b` is the only typecheck any gate runs — prek's `tsc` hook and _validate.yml's node-matrix `Typecheck (tsc -b)` step — so a project outside it is a project nothing checks, and `npm run typecheck:e2e-tauri` was invoked by nothing for as long as it existed. The old note here claimed being outside `tsc -b` kept wdio.conf.ts and e2e-tauri/** out of the bundle; that never held. `noEmit` is set, `tsc -b` emits nothing, and the bundle's inputs come from index.html via `vite build`, which is a separate command that does not read this file. What DOES require a separate project is the globals: `mocha`'s ambient describe/it and `@wdio/globals`' ambient $/$$/browser must not leak into src/** or into the Playwright suite, and separate projects already give that. Run standalone: `npm run typecheck:e2e-tauri`.
